subject: Post-demo recap: Dedicated GPU footprint, isolation & SLOs
messages:
From: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@acme-robotics.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up from today's demo / rough numbers

Hi Maya / Ben,

Thanks for the demo earlier — appreciate the run-through. Quick recap from our side so we're aligned on the ask and constraints: 

- Pain points: production latency spikes during peak inference (90th percentile ~700ms today), token unit cost is a concern, and we need strong tenant isolation for IP-protection across business units.
- Goals: predictable 95%ile latency <200ms for single-turn generation (avg seq 128 tokens), cost below $0.015/token after optimizations, and formal SLA for uptime/latency for the inference layer.
- Scale needs: starting footprint ~8x A100-equivalent GPUs with burst to 12 for seasonal bursts; ~1k qps peak request rate expected once we go live.
- Compliance: we need basic audit logs and mention of SOC2 compliance in any procurement docs.

Procurement timeline: vendor shortlist decision in 4–6 weeks, procurement sign-off in ~8–10 weeks. We can run a two-week POC / throughput test if you can provide isolated pool access or a compatible dedicated environment.

Next asks from us: ballpark monthly pricing for a dedicated pool with the above footprint, a short MAP (mutual action plan) we can walk our procurement through, and confirmation you can provide tenant isolation and audit logs.

I'll loop procurement on the next note.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of ML Ops
Acme Robotics

Attachments: none
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo / rough numbers

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary. Short reply with next steps and a few clarifications so we can size the MAP and POC appropriately.

Summary (what we heard):
- SLO target: 95th perc latency <200ms for single-turn 128-token generation.
- Expected steady footprint: 8 A100-equivalents; burst to 12.
- Peak qps: ~1k; typical qps off-peak ~250.
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence and audit logs required.

Clarifying Qs (please confirm):
1) Are those 8 GPUs reserved as a single isolated pool (dedicated) or are you open to a split configuration (6 reserved + 2 burst on shared/spot)?
2) Do you require customer-managed KMS/HSM for key material?
3) Any data residency constraints (EU/APAC)?

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
- We will share a draft MAP (attached: RDW-MAP-draft-Acme-20260621.pdf) that outlines milestones (POC setup, performance verification, security review, procurement).
- Ben (cc'd) will scope the engineering runbook for dedicated pool sizing and isolation mechanics.
- Dylan (cc'd) can schedule a 60m technical deep-dive to validate KV cache behavior and batching expectations; suggested times next week.
- We can provision a short-lived dedicated pool for a two-week POC with synthetic load to validate the 95th %-ile target.

Ballpark commercial note (very rough): dedicated pool (8 A100-equivalent) with isolation add-on and 30-day POC — approx $40k–$55k/mo depending on sustain/commit and networking needs. Formal pricing after a confirmation call.

I'll hold on the MAP finalization until you confirm the clarifying items above.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: RDW-MAP-draft-Acme-20260621.pdf
From: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@acme-robotics.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo / rough numbers

Maya — good notes. Quick answers:
1) Prefer fully isolated reserved pool for initial launch (single-tenant). We can evaluate split config later.
2) Yes, we require KMS integration (customer-managed keys).
3) No cross-region constraints — US only for now.

Procurement: our legal/procurement would like the MAP and a sample SLA clause referencing 99.9% availability for the inference endpoint and latency targets (95th <200ms) to consider in the RFP.

We are OK moving forward with a POC in July; aim to finalize vendor shortlist by end of July. I'll have procurement reach out to confirm contracting timeline.

Also sending over a preliminary traffic profile (will attach in a separate email).

Thanks,
Jordan

Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo / rough numbers — scheduling technical deep-dive + MAP next actions

Jordan / team — great, appreciate the clarifications. Looping in Ben (SE) for isolation architecture and Dylan (reliability) for latency/SLO tuning. Procurement copied for visibility.

Immediate asks from Redwood to keep momentum:
- Confirm two 60-minute windows next week for a technical deep-dive (Ben/Dylan) — options: Tue 2026-06-29 09:00–10:00 PT or Wed 2026-06-30 11:00–12:00 PT.
- Please share the traffic profile when available so we can create realistic synthetic test plans.
- Procurement: we'll prepare a MAP and a draft SLA clause (99.9% availability + latency target language) and post the MAP to the HubSpot company record and the DocuSign test link.

What we'll deliver before the deep-dive:
- Isolation architecture diagram (attached: isolation-arch-diagram.png).
- A one-page POC test-plan with success criteria for latency and throughput.
- Ballpark commercial schedule tied to commit levels and longer-term support.

If that works I'll lock the Tue slot and Ben/Dylan will send calendar invites.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
